Creating a Smile 
Across Every Mile
Positioned at the intersection of 
mobility, tourism, hospitality and 
digital services, IRCTC has built an 
integrated ecosystem that touches 
millions of lives every day. Through 
our diversified portfolio spanning 
Internet Ticketing, Catering, Tourism 
and Rail Neer, we create value across 
every touchpoint of the passenger 
journey. Whether it is simplifying 
access to travel through digital 
platforms, delivering quality hospitality 
onboard, curating memorable tourism 
experiences or ensuring the availability 
of safe drinking water, each of our 
businesses contributes to a reliable 
and customer-centric travel ecosystem.
This philosophy shaped our 
performance during FY2025-26. 
Driven by resilient growth across all 
four business verticals, disciplined 
execution and sustained operational 
excellence, IRCTC delivered its highest-
ever revenue, while also declaring the 
highest dividend in the Company’s 
history. More importantly, these 
achievements reflect the strength 
of a diversified business model that 
continues to create enduring value 
through operational resilience, digital 
innovation and customer trust.
India's travel and tourism ecosystem is undergoing a significant 
transformation. Rapid digital adoption, sustained investments in railway and 
transport infrastructure, rising domestic tourism and evolving passenger 
expectations are redefining the way people travel. As mobility becomes 
increasingly connected and experience-driven, the opportunity extends 
beyond enabling journeys to enriching every stage of the travel experience.
As India’s travel economy continues to expand, IRCTC 
is uniquely positioned to support this growth by 
strengthening digital capabilities, expanding tourism 
offerings, enhancing passenger convenience and 
strengthening service excellence across its businesses. 
Every investment, innovation and service we deliver is 
guided by a singular purpose: creating greater value for 
passengers, partners, shareholders and the nation.

Chairman’s Message
Creating a Smile Across Every Mile
Dear Shareholders,
For over two and a half decades, IRCTC 
has played an integral role in India’s 
railway ecosystem, serving millions 
of passengers through hospitality, 
tourism, and digital ticketing. As 
the scale and aspirations of Indian 
travelers have grown, so too has our 
responsibility to enhance the passenger 
experience and create value across 
every mile of the journey.
This focus underpinned a landmark 
performance of IRCTC in FY 2025–26. 
IRCTC delivered its highest-ever 
financial results, with Revenue from 
Operations growing by 11.55% to 
₹5,215 crore (approx.). Profit before 
Tax stood at ₹1,875 crore, EBITDA 
increased by 8.30% to ₹1,926 crore 
and Profit after Tax stood at ₹1,393 
crore. Reflecting the strength of our 
performance and our commitment to 
shareholder value, the Board of IRCTC 
has recommended a final dividend 
of ₹0.50 per share, subject to the 
approval of the shareholders, taking 
the total dividend per share to ₹9.00 
and total dividend payout for the 
year to ₹720 crore.
Delivering excellence across 
every mile
Each of our four business verticals 
delivered meaningful growth during FY 
2025-26, contributing to a resilient and 
well-balanced performance.
Catering remained our highest 
revenue-generating business recording 
an annual revenue of ₹2,399 crore and 
reflecting a growth of 12.88% over 
the previous year. We now serve close 
to 63 crore plus meals annually across 
approximately 1,450 plus passenger 
trains, supported by a network of 
more than 800 plus kitchens equipped 
with state of art equipment and AI-
enabled Quality Monitoring Systems. 
The E-Catering Business further 
expanded its reach to 420 plus railway 
stations, with 1.65 lakh plus average 
daily orders. During FY 2025-26, we 
also introduced E-Pantry services on a 
pilot basis across select Mail-Express 
trains, enabling passengers to pre-
book meals for seat-wise delivery; 
further enhancing service delivery and 
achieving customer delight through our 
digital hospitality platform.
In FY 2025-26, Rail Neer Package 
Drinking Water grossed a revenue of 
₹407crore approx., while profit grew by 
20.65% year-on-year. During the year, 
Rail Neer was also integrated with the 
E-Pantry service on 38 Mail-Express 
trains expanding passengers’ access to 
safe drinking water, through a digital 
ordering system.
Internet Ticketing generated a revenue 
of ₹1,536 crore approx., registering 
year-on-year growth of 7.66%. E-Tickets 
now account for 88.74% of reserved 
railway ticket bookings. This reflects 
how deeply our internet ticketing 
platform has become embedded in 
India’s travel ecosystem. The Average 
Daily Ticket Bookings increased to 
14.5 lakh with a record 18.40 lakh 
tickets booked in a single day on 19th 
August 2025. In FY 2025-26, IRCTC’s 
Rail Ticket Booking Mobile App - IRCTC 
Rail Connect crossed 17.71 crore 
downloads with 53% of all bookings 
now being done by our customers 
through mobile devices, further 
reinforcing our mobile-first approach.
Beyond train ticketing, IRCTC’s own 
Travel Platform – www.irctctourism.
com has evolved into a comprehensive 
Travel Services Hub, enabling 
passengers to manage their end-
to-end journeys through a single 
digital interface. 
Tourism delivered another year 
of robust growth, with revenue 
increasing by 19.49% to ₹890 crore, 
while profit grew by an impressive 
35.90%. Our portfolio of Bharat Gaurav 
Tourist Trains, luxury rail journeys, 
and pilgrimage circuits witnessed a 
strong demand. During the year, we 
launched the North East Discovery 
Bharat Gaurav Tourist Train, providing 
Integrated Rail-Based Travel across 
Assam, Arunachal Pradesh, Meghalaya, 
Nagaland, and Tripura. In recognition 
of the quality and innovation of our 
tourism offerings, IRCTC was felicitated 
with several awards and accolades by 
the Travel and Tourism Industry such 
as Seven Star Luxury Hospitality and 
Lifestyle Awards and VETA 2026 Award 
for National Excellence in Rail Tourism 
and Travel Services.
Building a Connected Travel 
Ecosystem
Our digital infrastructure continued to 
scale in line with growing passenger 
demand. The Next Generation 
e-Ticketing platform achieved peak 
processing capacity of over 37,000 
tickets per minute, strengthening 
reliability during periods of high 
demand. Aadhaar-authenticated 
Tatkal bookings also gained traction, 
with adoption increasing from 
6.77% to 17.74%, thereby enhancing 
booking security.
Our co-branded RuPay credit card 
programmes with SBI, Bank of Baroda, 
HDFC Bank, and RBL Bank generated 
revenue of ₹52.33 crore, reflecting 
year-on-year growth of 18% and 
deepening passenger engagement 
beyond the rail journey.
Advancing Responsible and 
Inclusive Growth
Our business streams bring with 
them a clear responsibility to use 
resources more thoughtfully and 
contribute meaningfully to the 
communities we serve.
At Rail Neer Plants, we have put in 
place structured systems for plastic 
waste collection and recycling under 
our Extended Producer Responsibility 
framework. Our plants also utilise 
solar evaporation ponds, rainwater 
harvesting, and water recycling systems 
to manage water responsibly, with 
120 KW of installed solar capacity 
across three facilities supporting 
cleaner production.
Our responsibility extends well beyond 
our operations. During the year, we 
supported the creation of a sustainable 
solid waste management ecosystem in 
Kinnaur in partnership with the Healing 
Himalayas Foundation, contributed to 
school nutrition through the Akshaya 
Patra Mid-Day Meal Programme, and 
strengthened access to preventive 
healthcare in communities around 
our operations.
Creating a Smile at Every 
Mile
India is travelling more, exploring more, 
and expecting more from every journey. 
For IRCTC, this presents a broader 
canvas that calls for stronger digital 
platforms, wider tourism offerings, 
and a consistently superior passenger 
experience. Our focus is to stay ahead 
of these evolving expectations by 
leveraging our reach, technology, and 
capabilities to create value across every 
mile of India’s growing travel economy.
As we pursue these opportunities, 
the principles by which we conduct 
our business will remain equally 
important. At IRCTC, we firmly believe 
that robust Corporate Governance is 
the cornerstone of sustainable value 
creation and long-term stakeholder 
trust. Guided by the principles of 
integrity, transparency, accountability, 
and ethical conduct, your Company 
remains steadfastly committed to 
maintaining the highest benchmarks 
of governance in alignment with 
relevant regulations and applicable 
laws. We continuously refine our 
internal oversight, risk management 
frameworks, and disclosure practices 
to ensure that administrative growth 
and digital innovation go hand in 
hand with institutional responsibility, 
thereby safeguarding the interests of 
our shareholders, passengers, and the 
nation at large.
I thank every member of Team IRCTC 
for the commitment they bring to this 
organization each day. I also express my 
sincere appreciation to our passengers, 
shareholders, business partners, and all 
other stakeholders for the continued 
trust they repose in IRCTC. Together, 
we will continue to serve a nation on 
the move and build an IRCTC that is 
ready for the journeys ahead.
Warm Regards,
Rahul Himalian 
Chairman and Managing Director.

Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Ltd. (IRCTC), a 
Navratna Central Public Sector Enterprise under the Ministry of 
Railways, Government of India, serves as the hospitality, tourism 
and online ticketing arm of Indian Railways. By integrating digital 
platforms, catering, tourism and travel services, we have created a 
comprehensive ecosystem that enhances convenience and enriches 
the travel experience for millions of passengers.
Since 1999, our journey has evolved 
in step with India's rapidly expanding 
railway network and the nation's 
growing mobility aspirations. Guided 
by innovation, operational excellence 
and a customer-first approach, we have 
expanded our capabilities, building 
an integrated travel platform that 
supports seamless journeys while 
contributing to the growth of India's 
travel and tourism economy.
